2. State main technical and design decisions and any additional assumptions used.

4. Calculate total most likely effort as sum.

The specification: It's about Spring Framework, but actually the user stories seem to be about Spring XD (Spring Data Flow predecessor) or some batch/data ingestion project. The stories:
U1: Benchmark Sqoop vs jdbchdfs batch job (QA wants to benchmark). This is maybe creating a benchmark test or job? As a developer, implementing software increment: maybe develop a benchmark harness or job to compare? Or just enable benchmarking? The requirement is for QA to benchmark, so we might need to provide a batch job or tool to do benchmarking, or ensure metrics are available. We'll assume we need to implement a benchmark job/script for comparison.
U2: Disable snappy compression when using hdfs-dataset sink with Avro files; also provide a different codec. So modify hdfs-dataset sink to support configuration of compression codec (including none, snappy, others).
U3: Mail sink to connect to secured IMAP/SMTP with TLS. Currently doesn't support TLS. Need to add java-mail-properties attribute to Mail sink config, support SSL/TLS properties.
U4: Use partitionResultsTimeout attribute for jobs that inherit singlestep-partitioning strategy, expose as metadata attribute in wiki. So need to expose property in metadata, ensure available for all jobs that import; 3 OOTB jobs have it imported. So code change to expose attribute and update docs/wiki.
U5: Upgrade to Spring Boot 1.2.0 RELEASE and associated dependencies (list of versions). So dependency upgrade, code adaptation to API changes, testing.
U6: Separate YML file to list deployment manifest properties, so user doesn't include in stream definition. Need to implement loading of deployment manifest from YML file in addition to stream definition.
U7: Option to compress messages (gzip, zip compression/decompression) - likely a general compression module or feature for messages. Could be in some messaging/transport layer.
U8: Option of compression for both Rabbit source and sink modules. So add compression support to Rabbit source and sink.
